## Overview

IronTrack is a production-ready monorepo fitness tracking app with NestJS API, FastAPI ML service, React web, and React Native mobile clients. The plan follows a **horizontal layering** approach: complete the backend first, then web frontend, then mobile, then ML service. Implementation targets a solo developer using AI assistance.

**Tech stack summary**: Nx + pnpm monorepo | NestJS + Prisma + PostgreSQL | FastAPI (Python) | React (Vite) | React Native (Expo) | Docker Compose

---

## Decisions Log

| # | Decision | Choice | Rationale |
|---|----------|--------|-----------|
| D1 | Auth strategy | Email/password + Google OAuth | User selected; no password reset email for MVP |
| D2 | User model additions | Add `timezone` (String) + `unitPreference` (METRIC/IMPERIAL enum) | Critical for streak calculation & weight display |
| D3 | Set payload storage | Hybrid: JSON `payload` + denormalized `weight`, `reps`, `durationSeconds` columns | Enables SQL-level aggregation for volume/PR queries while keeping flexible JSON |
| D4 | Mobile offline storage | SQLite via `expo-sqlite` | Relational structure suits workout data; better query support than AsyncStorage |
| D5 | Soft deletes | `deletedAt` on all core entities | ExerciseTemplate, WorkoutTemplate, WorkoutSession, SessionExercise, Set |
| D6 | Caching | No Redis for MVP | In-memory rate limiter, DB-stored refresh tokens, no background queue |
| D7 | Refresh token storage | DB table (`RefreshToken` model) | No Redis — store hashed tokens in PostgreSQL |
| D8 | Implementation phasing | Horizontal: backend → web → mobile → ML | User preference for solo development |
| D9 | API module structure | Feature modules (auth, user, exercise, workout, progress, checklist) | Simpler for solo dev; DDD later if needed |
| D10 | Python dependency management | Poetry with `pyproject.toml` | Modern Python standard, lockfile, virtual env |
| D11 | Optimistic locking | Add `version: Int` field on WorkoutSession, SessionExercise | Enables conflict detection for concurrent/offline edits |
| D12 | `lower(name)` unique constraint | Raw SQL migration for expression index | Prisma doesn't support function-based indexes natively |

## Phase 1: Prisma Schema & Database

**Goal**: Complete Prisma schema with all models, relations, enums, indexes, constraints. Migrations and seed data.

### Steps

- [ ] **1.1** Initialize Prisma in `apps/api`: `npx prisma init`
- [ ] **1.2** Define all enums: ExerciseType, SessionStatus, EndedReason, VideoProvider, PrType, StreakType, ChecklistType, UnitPreference, AuthProvider
- [ ] **1.3** Define all models (18 total) with schema amendments (see table below)
- [ ] **1.4** Write raw SQL migration for `lower(name)` expression index on ExerciseTemplate
- [ ] **1.5** Create seed script `apps/api/prisma/seed.ts` (14 muscle groups, 8 equipment, 50+ exercises)
- [ ] **1.6** Run `npx prisma migrate dev --name init` and `npx prisma db seed`
- [ ] **1.7** Generate Prisma client and verify all relations compile
- [ ] **1.8** Implement Prisma soft-delete middleware (auto WHERE deletedAt IS NULL, convert delete → update)

### Schema Amendments (additions to prompt spec)

| Model | Field Added | Type | Reason |
|-------|------------|------|--------|
| User | timezone | String? (default "UTC") | Streak date boundary (D2) |
| User | unitPreference | UnitPreference (default METRIC) | kg/lbs display (D2) |
| User | authProvider | AuthProvider (default LOCAL) | Google OAuth (D1) |
| User | googleId | String? (unique) | Google OAuth linking (D1) |
| User | avatarUrl | String? | Profile picture |
| Set | weight | Float? | Denormalized for SQL aggregation (D3) |
| Set | reps | Int? | Denormalized for SQL aggregation (D3) |
| Set | durationSeconds | Int? | Denormalized for SQL aggregation (D3) |
| Set | rpe | Float? | Denormalized for analytics (D3) |
| WorkoutSession | version | Int (default 1) | Optimistic locking (D11) |
| SessionExercise | version | Int (default 1) | Optimistic locking (D11) |
| RefreshToken (NEW) | id, userId, tokenHash, expiresAt, createdAt, revokedAt | — | Refresh token DB storage (D7) |
| All core models | deletedAt | DateTime? | Soft delete (D5) |
| PRRecord | setId | FK → Set? | PR provenance tracking |
| PRRecord | sessionId | FK → WorkoutSession? | PR provenance tracking |
| WorkoutTemplate | orderIndex | Int? | Dashboard ordering |

## Phase 4: Business Logic Services

**Goal**: PR detection, volume calculation, streak management, muscle coverage, completion logic.

### PR Detection

- [ ] **4.1** PrDetectionService triggered on session finish / set completion
- [ ] **4.2** Detect: MAX_WEIGHT, MAX_REPS, MAX_VOLUME, MAX_1RM_EST (Epley: weight × (1 + reps/30))
- [ ] **4.3** Upsert PRRecord with setId/sessionId provenance
- [ ] **4.4** Return new PRs for celebration UI
- [ ] **4.5** Recalculation on set edit/delete

### Volume Calculation

- [ ] **4.6** Per-set volume by exercise type
- [ ] **4.7** Session aggregate using denormalized columns
- [ ] **4.8** Cache in WorkoutSession.totalVolume on finish
- [ ] **4.9** Recalculate on post-finish edits

### Streak Calculation

- [ ] **4.10** Check UserStreak on session finish (streakType: WORKOUT)
- [ ] **4.11** UTC → user timezone conversion for local date
- [ ] **4.12** Increment/reset logic: same day=noop, consecutive=increment, gap=reset to 1
- [ ] **4.13** Checklist streak: trigger when all 4 items completed for a day

### Muscle Coverage

- [ ] **4.14** GET /api/v1/progress/weekly — coverage % (primary + secondary muscles)
- [ ] **4.15** Per-muscle-group volume for muscle map visualization

### Completion

- [ ] **4.16** Completion % = completedSets / totalSets × 100
- [ ] **4.17** Incomplete workout detection (trigger warning modal)

### Superset

- [ ] **4.18** Group by supersetGroupKey in session/template
- [ ] **4.19** Interleave sets display logic (A1→B1→A2→B2)
- [ ] **4.20** Mid-workout superset add/remove

## Phase 5: ML Service (FastAPI)

**Goal**: Stateless Python ML service with rule-based logic.

### Steps

- [ ] **5.1** Initialize with Poetry in `apps/ml/`
- [ ] **5.2** Structure: app/main.py, api/v1/, models/, services/, core/config.py
- [ ] **5.3** Pydantic v2 request/response models
- [ ] **5.4** Rule-based services:
  - Next Load: +2.5kg if last 3 sets at target reps with RPE < 8
  - Rest Time: compound heavy → 3-5min, isolation → 60-90s, superset → 30s
  - Pain Pattern: flag RPE 10 for 3+ sessions, dramatic weight drops
  - Session Recommender: suggest template covering underworked muscles
- [ ] **5.5** GET /health endpoint
- [ ] **5.6** NestJS MlClientModule with HttpService
- [ ] **5.7** pytest tests

| Settings / Profile | P1 | No way to edit user info, units, logout |
| Workout History | P1 | No historical workout list view |

## Risk Register

| # | Risk | Severity | Mitigation |
|---|------|----------|------------|
| R1 | JSON payload queries slow | High | Denormalized columns (D3) + indexes |
| R2 | Streak timezone edge cases | High | User timezone (D2) + midnight boundary tests |
| R3 | Offline sync data loss | High | SQLite (D4) + idempotency + sync queue |
| R4 | lower(name) not Prisma-native | Medium | Raw SQL migration (D12) + app validation |
| R5 | Prisma monorepo hoisting | Medium | Pin version, postinstall generate |
| R6 | Active workout state loss (web) | Medium | localStorage persistence |
| R7 | PR recalculation on edit/delete | Medium | Full history scan |
| R8 | Scope creep (18 models + 6 apps) | High | Strict horizontal phasing |
